items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: But, we got very close around there.

ctx.x: And I, oh before, before I went into the Savoy, Taft came down to the Harlem Opera House first to see me when I was there, when I was doing "Shine", the high C's and all that stuff. And then, I met him again at the Savoy.

But, we got very close around there. Even I, when Taft took off some time, Chick came to me and Taft came and asked me would I go out with Chick for a one-night stand. You know, cause Taft had the big chair in the band.
So, I don't know where Taft is now.
